title: A Review of Generative AI in Computer Science Education: Challenges and Opportunities in Accuracy, Authenticity, and Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and thematic analysis of prior studies evaluating how AI models trained on non-inclusive datasets may overlook cultural or contextual differences in problem-solving, disproportionately negatively impacting students from diverse backgrounds.

Literature review assessing concerns that AI-driven grading systems may unfairly favor specific coding styles based on skewed training data, leading to biased and unfair student evaluations in computer science.
